Baseball.why: k shrinks the difference between two clubs' season log-odds; 0.50 reflects that a best-of-series meeting between a .636 and a .605 club is close. Home edge 0.16 in logit units is the long-run MLB home-field figure (~54%).

Ice Hockey.why: Points-percentage log-odds shrunk by 0.55 (an 11-game sample is noisy) plus a 0.20 home term (~55% home win rate in the NHL).

Snooker.why: Strength is a 0-100 blend of frames won in this event (50%) and a rank score (37-position)/36 where the player is inside the published top 36 (50%). The 2.40 coefficient maps a 0.20 strength gap onto roughly a 61% best-of-7 win chance.

Rugby Union.why: No league table was readable, so the strength term is switched off entirely and only a 0.12 home term is applied. Confidence is capped at Low.

field.why: Outright weight = (points + 10)^1.5. The offset keeps zero-point drivers priced as longshots rather than at infinite odds; the exponent prices a 340-point leader at roughly 22% in a 23-driver field.

band.note: Brief: focus on selections priced between -250 (1.40) and +10000 (101.0).

flags.title: The brief's -250 floor and its 70% threshold cannot both be satisfied once a bookmaker margin exists
flags.detail: A selection with a 70% chance prices at 1.4286 fair, i.e. about -233. Add any margin and it quotes at roughly 1.37, about -270. So a pick that is genuinely 70%+ almost always prices shorter than the -250 floor the brief asks us to stay above. This desk publishes the probability, the fair decimal price and an in-band yes/no for every selection rather than silently dropping either rule. Of the 26 selections at 70% or better on this board, 16 price shorter than -250.

flags.title: MLB returns World Series games out of chronological order
flags.detail: The schedule API lists gamePk 849805 (23 Oct), 849802 (24 Oct), 849804 (26 Oct) and 849803 (27 Oct). The gamePk sequence is therefore not chronological and the payload reports gameNumber 1 for all four games. No game number is asserted anywhere on this site; the dates and venues are quoted exactly as returned.

flags.title: Leinster v Munster has no confirmed venue
flags.detail: The official URC Round 4 release prints the venue as "TBC, Dublin". Rather than naming the Aviva Stadium or the RDS, the row keeps the published text and the venue is flagged.

flags.title: No URC league table could be read, so eight rugby matches are priced from a neutral baseline
flags.detail: unitedrugby.com/urc/table and unitedrugby.com/standings both returned HTTP 404. Without a table there is no sourced strength input for either side, so the model switches its strength term off, applies only a home term, and caps confidence at Low. No handicap or total is originated for these matches because a line would have to be invented.

flags.title: Eight snooker rows have no start_utc
flags.detail: wst.tv prints "08:00", "09:00", "14:00" and "15:00" against "Thu 22 Oct" with no zone. A conversion would be arithmetic on a rendering, so start_utc is empty for all eight rows and the published clock is stored verbatim in start_published.

flags.title: The WST ranking table served only positions 1-36
flags.detail: Ten of the sixteen players in Round 3 fall outside the 36 rows the site served, so their world ranking and prize-money values are blank. They are described only as "outside the published top 36", which is what the page supports, and their strength input is built from frames won in this event instead.

flags.title: Darts could not be harvested: pdc.tv serves a consent wall
flags.detail: https://www.pdc.tv/tournament-hub/10824 returned the CookieYes consent interstitial and eight further chunks of cookie policy, with no fixture content. No darts row is published.

flags.title: Handball, greyhounds and NBA endpoints failed outright
flags.detail: ehfcl.com/en/men/fixtures-and-results returned HTTP 404; gbgb.org.uk/racing/fixtures returned HTTP 500; cdn.nba.com's live scoreboard returned HTTP 500. None of the three sports has a published row on this desk.

flags.title: Cricket, basketball and Aussie Rules boards render entirely in the browser
flags.detail: icc-cricket.com/fixtures-results returned nine repeated "loading" blocks and no fixture; euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/game-center returned a team list with an empty schedule; afl.com.au/aflw/fixture returned navigation chrome only. These sports are reported as unverified rather than guessed.

flags.title: Tennis cannot be placed on a date from an official draw sheet
flags.detail: The official ATP draw PDFs publish pairings, seeds and rankings but no per-match dates, and the tour calendar pages for this week are client-rendered. Assigning a date would be an inference, so no tennis fixture is published even though draws exist.

flags.title: The official GAA board publishes no senior gaelic football fixture for 22-26 October
flags.detail: gaa.ie/fixtures-results for October 2026 lists one match in the window, the Shinty-Hurling International between Ireland and Scotland at SuperValu Pairc Ui Chaoimh on 24 October, which is hurling and therefore out of scope. No gaelic football row is published.

flags.title: The United States Grand Prix start time is derived, not published in UTC
flags.detail: formula1.com prints session times in track-local time only. The 21:00Z race start comes from the two clocks the page displays side by side (my time UTC-4, track time UTC-5). The race is Sunday 25 October at 16:00 track time; qualifying is Saturday at 17:00.

flags.title: No starting pitcher is published for the World Series games in the fetched payload
flags.detail: The MLB schedule payload with the field filter used here carries no probablePitcher, so the pitching matchup is not modelled and the game-level prices rest on season records and home field alone. A reader should treat the baseball prices as the softest on the board.

flags.title: Twelve of the seventeen in-scope sports have no verified fixture on this desk
flags.detail: Five sports are covered (baseball, ice hockey, rugby union, snooker, motor racing) with 32 fixtures. The other twelve are listed on the coverage page with the exact URL that was tried and what came back.
